buildCommand: echo "SUPABASE_URL=$SUPABASE_URL" > .env && echo "SUPABASE_ANON_KEY=$SUPABASE_ANON_KEY" >> .env && git clone https://github.com/flutter/flutter.git -b stable --depth 1 _flutter && export PATH="$PWD/_flutter/bin:$PATH" && flutter config --enable-web --no-analytics && flutter pub get && flutter build web --release
